simple.meaning: מַעֲלָה (maʻălâh) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “elevation , i.e. the act (literally, a journey to a higher place, figuratively, a thought arising), or (concretely) the condition (literally, a step or grade -mark, figuratively, a superiority of station); specifically a climactic progression (in certain Psalms).” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 50 times across Exodus, Joshua, 1 Kings, 2 Kings, 1 Chronicles, and 7 more, beginning at Exodus 20:26. Its contexts include altar, death, kingship, Israel.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to מַעֲלָה (H4609).
simple.whyItMatters: Concept words shape biblical themes. BibleIQ keeps the concept grounded in actual verse evidence instead of starting with a later theological definition.

definitions.full: H4609. ma 'alah I. [ מַעֲלָה ] noun feminine what comes up ; — plural construct רוּחֲכֶם מַעֲלוֺת Ezek 11:5 , i.e. your thoughts. II. מַעֲלָה 46 noun feminine step, stair ; — ׳מ Ezra 7:9 ; 1Chr 17:17 ; plural מַעֲלוֺת Isa 38:8 +, suffix מַעֲלֹתָו֯ Amos 9:6 , etc.; — 1 step, stair of temple Ezek 40:6 5 t. 40, and temple porch 40:49 ; of altar Exod 20:26 (E) (forbidden, compare RS OTJC xii, n. l; 2nd ed. 358 ) Ezek 43:17 (prescribed); of house 2Kin 9:13 , of throne 1Kin 10:19-20 , 2Chr 9:18-19 , to the city of David Neh 3:15 ; 12:37 . 2 steps (forming sun-dial, compare Di Is ) 2Kin 20:9 (twice in verse); 20:10 (twice in verse); 20:11 (3 t. in verse) = Isa 38:8 (5 t. in verse) 3 stories of heaven Amos 9:6 . 4 ascent , מִבָּבֶל Ezra 7:9 . 5 . שִׁיר (ל)הַמַּעֲלוֺת song of ascents, to the three great pilgrim feasts, i.e. to be sung on way up to Jerusalem, titles of Psalm 120-134 + Psa 84:6 We and others — המעלה האדם כְּתוֺר 1Chr 17:17 is corrupt, see Commentaries on the passage (and on || 2Sam 7:19 ).
